6.202 rsMissingDataGroupings
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsMissingDataGroupings is a critical error that will occur when a CustomReportItem does not contain
at least one DataColumnGroupings.DataGroupings element and one
DataRowGroupings.DataGroupings element.
